about_the_game:
The World is on the brink of irreversible tragedy. Global tensions are rising, alliances are falling apart and states are preparing to decide their fate in the shadow of a massive war. Front Frontiers invites you to fight a massive war, offering an in-depth strategy experience where every country in the modern world can be managed.

  • Your every decision will shape the world order! At the lead of a country, you can build its economic power, outsmart your enemies with military strategies, or use your diplomatic intelligence But be careful! One wrong move could plunge your state into chaos.

  • Get the upper hand against your enemies with strategic moves in battle mechanics.

  • 🤝 Form alliances, use diplomacy and forge your own path in world politics.

  • 📈 Manage economic systems, strengthen your country by using your resources correctly and gain an advantage over your rivals with technological advances.

  • 🌍 All countries of the modern world are playable! From superpowers to small states, each country offers opportunities and challenges with its own unique leaders.

  • Shape history with alternative scenarios! Create a brand new world order with your own strategy or try to preserve the existing one.

War or Peace? Destruction or Victory? or OUR OWN DEMISE? Manage the flow of history!
